items.title: Nonacus report says funding gaps stall NHS adoption of new diagnostics such as GALEAS Bladder
items.summary: Birmingham diagnostics firm Nonacus's Faster Answers report argues NHS access to evidence-backed tests depends on local commissioning. Its urine-based GALEAS Bladder test is used at eight NHS sites; Leicester's pathway relies on time-limited funding ending April 2027.

items.title: Leicester trust cuts cystoscopies with at-home GALEAS Bladder urine test
items.summary: University Hospitals of Leicester NHS Trust is piloting GALEAS Bladder, a non-invasive home urine test analysing 23 genes associated with bladder cancer, and has reduced the number of patients needing a cystoscopy as a result.

items.title: Galeas Bladder urine DNA test detected 92.2% of bladder cancers in seven-trust NHS study
items.summary: A urine DNA test, Galeas Bladder (Nonacus Ltd), detected 92.2% of bladder cancers among patients referred for investigation, identifying 71 of 77 cancers in 964 patients including 35 of 36 high-grade cancers and every muscle-invasive case.

items.title: Clinical study finds urine test identifies more than 9 in 10 bladder cancers
items.summary: University of Birmingham (seen via Google Alert, 03/09/2026): a clinical study led by the University of Birmingham found a urine test identified over 90% of bladder cancers, reducing pressure on NHS urology diagnostic pathways.

items.title: Boston Scientific wins £12.8k urology laser replacement at Swansea Bay
items.summary: Swansea Bay University Health Board has directly awarded Boston Scientific a contract to replace the end-of-life urology laser at Morriston Hospital with a Lumenis MOSES Pulse 120H device, worth £12,822.15 excluding VAT.
